budget.title: Full-Day Mixed Budapest Highlights on a Budget + Local Food
budget.summary: A bit of history, a bit of nature, a bit of exploring — all without your wallet screaming. Local Hungarian bites included!

schedule.title: Parliament & Danube Morning Walk
schedule.description: Start your day with a chill walk along the river next to the Parliament. Great views, epic photos, zero stress.

schedule.title: Stroll Through the Old Town Streets
schedule.description: Check out the classic architecture, small squares, and cool corners of Budapest’s central district.

schedule.title: Budget Traditional Lunch
schedule.description: Hit an affordable Hungarian spot — soups, stews, or a big warm plate that tastes like home food.

schedule.title: City Park (Városliget) Chill
schedule.description: Walk around the lakes, trees, and castle-like buildings. Grab an inexpensive lemonade if you're thirsty.

schedule.title: Evening Street Walk
schedule.description: Finish with a sunset walk through lively streets before heading back or exploring more on your own.

comfortable.title: Full-Day Mixed Tour with Comfortable Local Dining
comfortable.summary: History, nature, and great food — the best of Budapest without rushing. Smooth, scenic, and tasty.

schedule.title: Buda Castle Morning
schedule.description: Start on the Buda side with castle views, cobblestone streets, and panoramas over the city.

schedule.title: Danube Riverside Walk
schedule.description: Walk back down by the river and enjoy the wide open views — super relaxing.

schedule.title: Comfort Local Lunch
schedule.description: Sit down at a nice Hungarian restaurant and enjoy something hearty or home-style.

schedule.title: City Park Exploration
schedule.description: Check out Vajdahunyad Castle, the lake, and leafy paths — take your time, it’s all very photogenic.

schedule.title: Evening Terrace with a Soft Drink
schedule.description: End with a lemonade or iced tea on a peaceful terrace.

budget.title: Full-Day Mixed Exploration with Light Budget Meals
budget.summary: A mix of classic Budapest moments with easy, lighter, veggie-friendly food options.

schedule.title: Morning City Center Walk
schedule.description: See big squares and main streets while everything’s still quiet.

schedule.title: Park Time
schedule.description: Head to the nearest park for a mini-nature break.

schedule.title: Light Veggie Lunch
schedule.description: Budget bistro with salads, soups, sandwiches, or simple bowls — whatever keeps things fresh.

schedule.title: Optional Cultural Stop
schedule.description: Drop into a small museum or gallery if you're curious — or continue exploring outdoors.

schedule.title: Evening Chill Spot
schedule.description: Finish in a relaxed street or river area with a lemonade or iced drink.

comfortable.title: Full-Day Mixed Tour with Comfortable Light Dining
comfortable.summary: Balanced highlight tour, lots of walking, plus high-quality lighter meals in comfy places.

schedule.title: Historic Center + Coffee
schedule.description: Walk through the prettiest streets and warm up with a good coffee or tea.

schedule.title: Green Escape
schedule.description: Visit a park or riverbank for calm, open spaces.

schedule.title: Light But Refined Lunch
schedule.description: A nice restaurant with creative veggie/light dishes — bowls, salads, soups.

schedule.title: Culture + Streets
schedule.description: Short museum visit followed by walking through cute side streets and shops.

schedule.title: Evening Terrace
schedule.description: End the day with an iced drink on a comfy terrace or riverside bench.

budget.title: Full-Day Mixed Route for Curious Eaters on a Budget
budget.summary: History, parks, and cheap-but-interesting bites all around Budapest.

schedule.title: Historic Squares Tour
schedule.description: See the big squares and important monuments without going too deep.

schedule.title: Park or Riverside Walk
schedule.description: A green break or a calm river walk — your choice.

schedule.title: Mixed Cheap Lunch
schedule.description: Try two or three small, affordable dishes so you can taste different things.

schedule.title: Shopping or Culture Mini-Stop
schedule.description: Check out a small museum, cute stores, or a flea-style market if available.

schedule.title: Snacks + Chill
schedule.description: End with some inexpensive snacks and a drink near the city center.

comfortable.title: Full-Day Mixed Highlights with Rich Food Variety
comfortable.summary: A day where you taste a bit of everything, see a lot, and enjoy Budapest’s best vibes.

schedule.title: Core City Intro
schedule.description: Start with historic streets, big buildings, and a few famous spots.

schedule.title: Green Stop
schedule.description: Head to a park or river walk to balance the day with calmer scenery.

schedule.title: Tasting-Style Lunch
schedule.description: Try several small dishes at a comfortable restaurant — perfect for curious eaters.

schedule.title: Culture or Shopping
schedule.description: Visit a gallery, museum, or lively shopping street.

schedule.title: Evening in a Good Café or Restaurant
schedule.description: Finish with a drink and maybe another little dish in a relaxed, friendly environment.
